facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports that 30% of health facilities report directly through DHIS2 in 2025, against an HSSP target of 55%, these being the facilities equipped with tablets and computers; the share is of all health facilities and no numerator or denominator is given, and completeness of the OPD and inpatient form (MOH F01A) in DHIS2 was 52.15% in 2024/25.

The Ministry of Health reports that in 2025 the 30% of health facilities equipped with tablets and computers enter their own reports directly in DHIS2, and that facilities providing TB and HIV services were given tablets and data bundles to do so.

The Ministry of Health states that hospitals and PHCCs often lack the computers, stable internet and trained staff to enter data directly into DHIS2, so that data entry is frequently centralised or delayed; it does not name the level at which the entry is done (FY 2024/25).

The Ministry of Health's assessment of health service institutions finds that many hospitals submit DHIS2 reports regularly and that DHIS2 reporting is common among them, with monthly reporting and verification inconsistent in some and internal data tools not yet linked (FY 2024/25).

The Minister of Health calls DHIS2 the official national health information platform and asks all stakeholders to avoid parallel platforms; in FY 2024/25 the ministry operationalised a monthly M&E Technical Working Group and wrote a Data Governance Framework into its HMIS SOPs.

The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2023-2027 sets targets for the proportion of health facilities reporting directly through DHIS2 of 55% by 2025 and 90% by 2027, as the Ministry of Health's report tabulates them; the same report records a HIS maturity score of 13% for strategic planning and 7% for HIS financing.

The Ministry of Health reports that in FY 2024/25 ICT hardware, solar power and Starlink connectivity were deployed to selected health facilities, a facility data clean-up validated about 70% of facilities in DHIS2 as the master facility list, and over 500 facilities were matched between DHIS2 and EWARS.
